evidence.evidence_scope: direct rendered title and chapter summary only
evidence.limitation: No original-media visual/audio review; factual claims require independent sourcing.

hypothesis: For fact-checked athlete biographies, opening with a single contrast between the public sports label and the documented private cost may improve early comprehension and sustained viewing versus a chronological résumé opening.
applicability: 人物经历已有当事人或权威来源
作品计划时长约 3–5 分钟
反差不依赖夸大死亡、疾病、关系或心理状态
disallowed: 没有可靠来源的私人经历
仅凭评论区推断人物关系或心理

single_primary_variable.name: opening_frame
single_primary_variable.control: 前 12 秒按履历或比赛成绩顺序介绍人物
single_primary_variable.treatment: 前 12 秒只用一句“公众竞技标签 vs 已核实私人代价”的反差问题；12 秒后与对照脚本完全相同

held_constant: 发布时间窗与发布渠道
封面与标题除开场句外不变

primary_metric.name: average_play_percentage
primary_metric.source: Douyin creator single-work analytics when the label is actually exposed
primary_metric.comparison: median of at least 3 similar athlete-story videos, matched on duration band and publication window
primary_metric.caveat: Average play percentage is not completion rate.

guardrails: 2-second exit rate, if exposed, must not worsen materially
fact corrections or credible accuracy complaints trigger immediate rejection regardless of retention
qc_requirements: Every private-life claim linked to an authoritative source with date
Accurate translation for any retained original-language quote
Only the opening copy differs between A and B

rollback.condition: Reject if the treatment average play percentage is at least 5 percentage points below the matched-control median after 72 hours, or if any material factual error is confirmed.
rollback.action: Remove the treatment hook and return to the chronological, source-led opening; keep evidence and failure receipt.

integration: pending; do not add to production learned-rules registries before rendered QC and real outcome review
